#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import os
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys


MAX_BYTES = 50000


def _find_container_runtime():
    if shutil.which("podman"):
        return "podman"
    if shutil.which("docker"):
        return "docker"
    raise RuntimeError("Neither podman nor docker is available on PATH")


def sandbox_run(
    command: str,
    workspace: str | None = None,
    image: str = "debian:stable-slim",
    timeout: int = 60,
    network: str = "none",
    memory: str = "2g",
    pids: int = 512,
    cpus: float = 2.0,
) -> str:
    runtime = _find_container_runtime()

    argv = [
        runtime, "run", "--rm", "--pull=missing",
        f"--network={network}",
        f"--memory={memory}",
        f"--pids-limit={pids}",
        f"--cpus={cpus}",
        "--cap-drop=ALL",
        "--security-opt=no-new-privileges",
    ]

    if workspace is not None:
        argv.extend(["-v", f"{workspace}:/workspace:rw", "-w", "/workspace"])

    argv.extend([image, "sh", "-c", command])

    try:
        result = subprocess.run(
            argv,
            capture_output=True,
            timeout=timeout,
            shell=False,
        )
        exit_code = result.returncode
    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
        exit_code = 124

    combined_len = len(result.stdout) + len(result.stderr)
    if combined_len > MAX_BYTES:
        marker = b" ... [truncated]"
        marker_len = len(marker)
        avail = MAX_BYTES - marker_len
        stdout_len = len(result.stdout)
        if stdout_len >= avail:
            raw_stdout = result.stdout[:avail] + marker
            raw_stderr = b""
        else:
            raw_stdout = result.stdout
            raw_stderr = result.stderr[:avail - stdout_len] + marker
    else:
        raw_stdout = result.stdout
        raw_stderr = result.stderr

    stdout = raw_stdout.decode(errors="replace")
    stderr = raw_stderr.decode(errors="replace")

    return f"exit={exit_code}\n--- stdout ---\n{stdout}--- stderr ---\n{stderr}"


def _main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="sandbox.py", add_help=False)
    parser.add_argument("--image", default="debian:stable-slim")
    parser.add_argument("--timeout", type=int, default=60)
    parser.add_argument("--network", default="none")
    parser.add_argument("--memory", default="2g")
    parser.add_argument("--pids", type=int, default=512)
    parser.add_argument("--cpus", type=float, default=2.0)
    parser.add_argument("--workspace", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--", dest="dash_dash", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("command", nargs="+")

    parsed = parser.parse_args()

    cmd_str = " ".join(parsed.command)
    workspace = parsed.workspace if parsed.workspace else os.getcwd()

    output = sandbox_run(
        command=cmd_str,
        workspace=workspace,
        image=parsed.image,
        timeout=parsed.timeout,
        network=parsed.network,
        memory=parsed.memory,
        pids=parsed.pids,
        cpus=parsed.cpus,
    )
    print(output)

    exit_line = output.split("\n")[0]
    if exit_line.startswith("exit="):
        exit_code = int(exit_line.split("=")[1])
        sys.exit(exit_code)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    _main()
